description: Niger - Multi-Tier Framework (MTF) Survey is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Surveys", published or maintained by Marina Brutinel, Farouk Nabourema, Bryan Bonsuk Koo, Sandra Keller (World Bank Group). The MTF survey is a global baseline survey on household access to electricity and clean cooking, which goes beyond the binary approach to look at access as a spectrum of service levels experienced by households. Resources included are raw data, codebook, questionnaires, sampling strategy document, and country diagnostic report. Coverage: Niger. It has 5 files in PDF, Other, XLS. The portal files it under Energy access, Surveys. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
